messages:
jules: FYI got alerts: multiple eu-central GPU nodes failing healthchecks after a firewall rule rollout at 03:12. Nodes can't reach the keystore privatelink endpoint. Bootstrap failing.

nav: which rule was rolled? any PR link?

jules: https://git.internal/r/redwood/networking/commit/aa9f4b - tightened outbound http egress for control-plane subnets to reduce blast radius. apparently we blocked the privatelink ENI IP range.

imani: logs from keystore-proxy show connection refused to 10.12.77.45:443 then KMS decrypt timeouts. sample: 
```
WARN keystore: dial tcp 10.12.77.45:443: connect: connection refused
ERROR node-bootstrap: decrypt failure: context deadline exceeded
```

triage-bot: [ALERT] fleet: 24 pending joins in eu-central; average install_time increased from 2m -> 18m.

sam: oh no. are we using privatelink for KMS in eu-central? thought KMS was regional endpoint.

nav: yes, we've got a privatelink proxy that front-ends KMS/HSM traffic for compliance. the ENIs live in shared-network account. The new fw rule used a CIDR denylist and accidentally excluded the ENI subnet 10.12.72.0/22.

security: tagging in. any change to firewall that affects keystore privatelink needs an approval ticket. please create one ASAP and annotate incident.

jules: incident created I-2026-059. Rolling back rule now.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued: network/firewall/rollout-129 -> rollback. ETA ~3m.

imani: small gotcha: some nodes already pulled keys and are up; others are mid-boot and retrying KMS frequently. we're seeing KMS QPS spike on the fallback regional endpoint.

nav: can we temporarily allow the ENI CIDR in the fw for control-plane, and then harden with a tag-based rule? quicker than full rollback.

security: temporary allowlist accepted for 30 minutes; must be logged and reverted.

jules: applying allowlist now. rule patch: 
```
- deny 0.0.0.0/0:443
+ allow 10.12.72.0/22:443
+ deny 0.0.0.0/0:443
```

triage-bot: [INFO] rollback patch applied. keystore privatelink reachable from control-plane subnets.

imani: decrypt errors subsiding. 18/24 nodes now progressed.

sam: curious - why did the rollout not hit our preflight? we have a network-canary that checks privatelink reachability.

nav: the canary runs from infra-proxy subnet, not control-plane. rollout targeted control-plane only. oversight in the change.

jules: adding a test to CI: run privatelink reachability from every control-plane AZ before accepting firewall PR. will open PR in a bit.

security: follow-ups: 1) docs for firewall rollouts referencing privatelink ENIs, 2) require approval tag for keystore-impacting rules, 3) audit log entry for this incident.

nav: cost note: we fired failover to public KMS for ~40 decrypts, minor increase in egress / KMS fees. rough estimate $320. adding to incident.

triage-bot: [CHECK] health: eu-central GPU pool capacity degraded 8% for 22 minutes. autoscaler compensated from other zones.

imani: also seeing increased latency on inference due to cross-zone warm-pool usage; perf team alerted.

jules: rolling post-mortem tasks into I-2026-059: add additional canary, update runbook, patch firewall PR template.

nav: PR for canary test: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/512 - adds privatelink probe from control-plane.

security: include an action to block CIDR-based allowlists in firewall rules that affect shared ENIs; prefer tag-based allow rules.

sam: one last note: we've seen similar fragility when HSM endpoints are behind privatelink. let's add a test matrix for HSM/KMS/privatelink during rollout.

imani: nodes fully joined now. queue drained. closing incident in 10m after monitoring.

triage-bot: Incident I-2026-059 status -> mitigated. postmortem required within 72h.

jules: thanks all. adding timestamps and logs to incident doc and will schedule a retro. :thanks:
